blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
An IT department has several different roles. The help desk answers everyday questions: a frozen laptop, a forgotten password, a printer problem. The infrastructure team looks after the servers, the network and the cloud accounts.

Developers build and maintain software. Security protects the company from threats. The IT director or CIO leads the whole function.

Knowing who does what saves you time. If the problem is your laptop, call the help desk. If you need a new app, talk to developers. If a strange email feels wrong, call security today, not tomorrow.

items.q: Who answers everyday questions like a frozen laptop or a forgotten password?
items.why: "The help desk answers everyday questions: a frozen laptop, a forgotten password…"

items.q: What does the infrastructure team look after?
options: The servers, the network and the cloud accounts
items.why: "The infrastructure team looks after the servers, the network and the cloud accounts."

items.q: Who leads the whole IT function?
items.why: "The IT director or CIO leads the whole function."

items.q: The text says to call security about a strange email "today, not tomorrow". This suggests that…
options: the help desk is closed tomorrow
security only works in the morning
a strange email can be a real risk, so time matters
items.why: Inferência: agir rápido só importa se o e-mail estranho puder ser uma ameaça real.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: the help desk can fix every problem
IT roles are all the same
knowing the right person saves you time
you should always call the CIO first
items.why: Inferência: "Knowing who does what saves you time." — a ideia central do texto.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver mostrando o organograma de TI para uma nova colega. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the team! Let me show you our IT org chart. It looks big, but it is simple.

See this box at the top? That is our CIO. She leads the whole department. You will not call her every day, but she sets the plan.

Here is the help desk. This is your first stop for small problems. A frozen laptop, a forgotten password, a printer that does not work — just call the help desk. They are friendly, I promise.

Next to them is the infrastructure team. They take care of the servers and the network. And these people are the developers. They build our apps. If you need a new tool for your work, talk to them.

Now, this box is very important. This is security. Please listen. If you get a strange email, an email that feels wrong, call security today. Not tomorrow, not next week — today. One bad email can be a real threat to the company. So when in doubt, always call security.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is in the box at the top of the org chart?
items.why: "See this box at the top? That is our CIO. She leads the whole department."

items.q: What should the new joiner do about a frozen laptop or a forgotten password?
items.why: "A frozen laptop, a forgotten password… just call the help desk."

items.q: Who should she talk to if she needs a new tool for her work?
items.why: "These people are the developers. They build our apps. If you need a new tool… talk to them."

items.q: Why does Oliver say to call security "today, not tomorrow"?
options: Because the help desk is closed
Because one bad email can be a real threat
Because security is very busy tomorrow
items.why: Inferência: "One bad email can be a real threat to the company." — por isso a urgência.

items.q: How would you best describe Oliver's tone?
items.why: Inferência: ele é acolhedor ("Welcome!", "They are friendly"), mas fica firme no ponto da segurança.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "My laptop is frozen and the screen will not move." A frozen laptop is…
options: a laptop that is very cold
items.why: Frozen laptop = notebook travado, que parou de responder.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I forgot my ___, so I cannot log in to my email."
items.why: Password = senha, o que você usa para fazer login.

items.q: "The office network is slow today." The network is…
options: the system that connects the computers
items.why: Network = rede, o sistema que conecta os computadores.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A strange email can be a real ___ to the company."
items.why: Threat = ameaça, um risco para a empresa.

items.q: "This strange email asks for my password." Strange here means…
items.why: Strange = estranho, algo fora do normal.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem no dia a dia de um time de TI. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please call the help desk if your laptop is frozen." To call the help desk means to…
options: send an email to the CIO
ask the IT support team for help
items.why: Call the help desk = pedir ajuda ao time de suporte de TI.

items.q: "IT will roll out the new app next week." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = lançar, colocar em uso para todos.

items.q: "Can you look after the servers this week?" To look after something means to…
items.why: Look after = cuidar de, tomar conta.

items.q: "If an email feels wrong, reach out to security." To reach out to someone means to…
options: wait for them to call you
items.why: Reach out to = entrar em contato com, procurar alguém.

items.q: "The CIO wants us to keep an eye on the network today." To keep an eye on means to…
items.why: Keep an eye on = ficar de olho, observar com atenção.
